notes.title: Version 0.0.6 - Second chapter of the game and more!
notes.notes:
changes:
- some more bugs fixed
- new options in main menu (language & audio tabs)
- second chapter (in this chapter there are gaps at the end, in the part with the boss, but I will add remaining content as soon as possible).
- 3 new music tracks in the game:)
There is not much time left, so please try to find as many errors as possible as soon as possible. Thnaks!

notes.title: Version 0.0.5 - bug fix
notes.notes:
- Repaired bugs found by @AzeİkoMaster, @a.chudek and @MACIOXDLAVE.
- 1/3 of the second chapter is already done, but you don't have access to it yet:)
- some kind of performance issues repaired (maybe lol)

Thanks for all the bugs you found! Let's keep it up! The premiere is coming soon, I'll try to deliver the second chapter for testing as soon as possible.
~PanGangowski

notes.title: Version 0.0.4 - bug fix and preparations for 2nd chapter!
notes.notes:
- more bugs found by @Natusia and @AzeIkoMaster repaired! Thanks!
- more bugs found by me repaired!
- unsuccessful optimisation efforts:( But I will be trying again soon;)
- New location (behind the lake in town) prepared for chapter two!
- Several additional objects in the city (for the second and third chapter).

notes.title: Version 0.0.3 - bug fix
notes.notes:
- game skips frames again (but at least it doesn't slow down)
- Changed the way boss health is displayed, from now on a health bar will appear on the screen.
- many outfits added (in total already 9 to be collected)
- minor other amendments which I have already forgotten xD

Good luck with your testing! Now is a good time for it! I'll do bug fix 0.0.4 and then start working on the second chapter of the adventure for good!
~Pan Gangowski
